verdict.rationale: First-party docs claim Cursor can inspect diffs, run checks, and catch problems before merge, and that it "reviews PRs in GitHub," indicating a PR-review capability. However there is no detail on what contextual feedback looks like, no independent/hands-on validation of PR-review quality, and community evidence is silent on this specific feature. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of PR-review mechanics/contextual feedback format, independent or hands-on verification that automatic review comments appear on real PRs, and evidence of accuracy/usefulness of the feedback.
